column1: # Known bugs of the reference stacks that show only against this image, in the
# format of tests/known-bugs.tsv (its header has the columns). The scripts read
# it through EXTRA_KNOWN_BUGS, which own/go-dnp3/Makefile and the Own stack
# workflow set. It is apart from tests/known-bugs.tsv because a row there that
# no run reproduces is stale and fails the run, and the release runs do not

column4: the master takes SAVE_CONFIGURATION (and every function it sends through PerformFunction) as failed when the response carries objects, but IEEE 1815-2012 4.4.12 has the outstation answer SAVE_CONFIG with a time delay object (g52v1 or g52v2), as go-dnp3 does; the other outstations answer with no object
